name: Al-Kindi (Abu Yusuf Ya'qub ibn Ishaq al-Kindi)
shortBio: The 'Philosopher of the Arabs' who inaugurated the translation movement at the House of Wisdom; synthesized Aristotle and Neoplatonism, arguing for cosmic finitude and temporal creation.
centralQuestion: Can natural philosophy and mathematical reason demonstrate the createdness and temporal finitude of the universe without contradicting rational logic?

keyWorks.title: On First Philosophy (Fi al-Falsafah al-Ula)
keyWorks.description: Foundational treatise on the First Truth, divine unity, and the logical impossibility of an infinite past or actual infinity in nature.

keyWorks.title: On the Quantity of the Books of Aristotle
keyWorks.description: Systematic syllabus introducing Aristotelian corpus and logic to the Arabic-speaking scholarly world.
